messages:
alex: Heads-up 5: two customer incidents where cost-first routing picked a cheaper variant and p99 spiked. Can we agree a minimal signal contract to avoid this class of failures?

maya: Yes. Short proposal: runtimes provide runtime.capacity_score (0-1) and runtime.p99_probe_ms. Policy treats missing as conservative.

sam: Agree. Also add signal_ts and a staleness policy (age > 15s -> degrade score).

eli: Implementation note: prefer adding a compiler adapter that normalizes per-runtime fields to these canonical names so we can roll out without touching every runtime.

jordan: Policy sketch: if capacity_score >= 0.6 && p99_probe_ms <= 300 -> allow cost-based tie-break up to 15% delta; otherwise hedge N=1 preferring latency.

rachel: Console UX: show normalized signals and a simulated decision preview, and make hedging opt-in per-tenant while sims run.

ops-bot: Created alert: "routing.hedge_rate_spike" threshold=10rps window=30s. Runbook: apply temporary hedging override.

alex: Action items: eli -> adapter mapping doc (ETA Wed); sam -> unit tests + sim (ETA Thu); maya -> RFC follow-up (ETA Tue); rachel -> console mock (ETA Mon). If no objections I9ll merge the follow-up RFC.

sam: SGTM.

maya: One caveat: hedging increases cross-region egress; Optimize needs a per-tenant sim to estimate cost impact.

alex: We'll gate global default on sim results and keep opt-in until validated. Thanks all.
